text: How many selectable digital filters does this device have? Ferrum's own two pages give four different answers: « two included at launch », « three filter settings », « four digital filters created for Ferrum by Signalyst », and « One is a part of the ESS DAC, and four were designed especially for WANDLA ». The readings are not even consistent in kind - some count ESS's, some Signalyst's, some both. It matters because selectable filters are a level-3 fact: which one is active changes what the device does to the signal, and a consumer that upsamples needs to know whether its own work will be filtered again. One email to Ferrum settles it.
